senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (लुप्यति)
To disturb, to bewilder, to perplex and confound the understanding.
(ऌ औ ऋ) औलुपॢ^1 r. 6th cl. (लुम्पति-ते)
1 To cut, to divide, to cut off or down.
2 To rob.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Gone, lost, disappeared.
2 (In grammar,) Cut, off, rejected.
n. (-प्तं)
Booty, plunder.
E.
लुप to rob, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
Disappearance, non-existence.
E.
लुप्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, लुप्तत्वं.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Deprived of funeral rites.
E.
लुप्त, पिण्डोदक cake and water, क्रिया rite.

f. (-मा)
An imperfect comparison.
E.
लुप्त, and उपमा simile.
